title: Pin affected critical workflows to the available Ubuntu 24.04 hosted runner

phases.objective: Replace the observed non-allocating ubuntu-latest alias only in the nine affected critical workflows with explicit ubuntu-24.04.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A pull request changes one of the affected critical workflow paths.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: Each allowlisted critical job requests ubuntu-24.04 and can receive a hosted runner while workflow permissions and behavior remain otherwise unchanged.
steps: Pin each allowlisted workflow from ubuntu-latest to ubuntu-24.04.
Reject any remaining ubuntu-latest label in the allowlist.
Preserve workflow triggers, permissions, commands, and safety boundaries.
Execute the runner-label pinning regression on the exact candidate head.
assertions: Exactly nine observed critical workflows are governed by the pinning regression.
Every allowlisted workflow contains runs-on: ubuntu-24.04.
No allowlisted workflow contains runs-on: ubuntu-latest.
No Production, provider, credential, SQL, Migration Apply, database, protected-ref, force-push, Work Map, or external mutation authority is added.

phases.objective: Confirm the affected Draft and Ready jobs obtain first-step timestamps.
Prevent accidental reintroduction of ubuntu-latest into the observed critical workflow allowlist.
Compare hosted allocation evidence after merge without triggering provider or Production actions.
Retain repository CI availability while preserving all existing runtime safety boundaries.
